**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what you're trying to achieve (e.g., "I want to compare my portfolio against the S&P 500").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of the new metric, chart, or engine you want to see.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other ways you've tried to get this data (e.g., "Currently doing this in Excel but it's slow").

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or financial formulas that would help in building this feature.
